repos.description: DeepSeek Harness: Everything is a Plugin.
repos.readme_snippet:
DeepSeek Harness
English | 中文
DeepSeek Harness (dsh) is an open-source agent harness developed by DeepSeek AI.
It uses an architecture where everything is a plugin, and is powered by Cordis, whose design is described in _A Programming Paradigm for Spatiotemporal Composability_.
Developer preview
